_comment: Embedded allowlist for the strict mach-lookup mode (config `sandbox.seatbelt.mach.lookup: strict`, corral's default).
macOS / Seatbelt only. In strict mode the profile emits `(deny mach-lookup)` then
`(allow mach-lookup <these services>)`; everything NOT listed is denied by absence — the
LaunchServices/quarantine escape path, the data-reach and telemetry services (pasteboard,
metadata.mds, contactsd, analyticsd, AddressBook), and windowserver/tccd. (Apple Events
cross-app RCE is NOT closed even by strict — the event uses no deniable mach-lookup; an
accepted OS-layer residual.) The opt-out mode is `open` (allow-default + scoped escape denies);
this file has NO effect there.
and both xcodebuild probes run clean under deny-default on exactly the first 19 services. The
last two (coreservicesd, diskarbitrationd) are low-risk core services observed during the
run but NOT required by that validated matrix — kept conservatively to avoid breaking
Foundation/build-heavy tools. `swift build` could not be derived here (it fails under nested
sandbox-exec for a NON-mach reason, so its ablation is invalid — its apparent need for
analyticsd was noise; telemetry stays denied). Users extend with `sandbox.seatbelt.mach.allow` (a trailing `*`
becomes a prefix). Names are case-sensitive; if a tool breaks under strict, re-derive and add it.

services.name: com.apple.trustd
services.description: TLS certificate validation (crypto/x509, curl, git https)

services.name: com.apple.system.opendirectoryd.membership
services.description: group membership (getgrouplist) — breaks clang if denied

services.name: com.apple.secinitd
services.description: sandbox/XPC initialization for newly spawned processes

services.name: com.apple.CoreServices.coreservicesd
services.description: UTI/type resolution (Foundation); low-risk core service, observed in derivation, not required by the validated matrix

services.name: com.apple.SecurityServer
services.description: keychain, Secure Transport, code-signature validation, git credential helper

services.name: com.apple.DiskArbitration.diskarbitrationd
services.description: disk/volume arbitration; low-risk core service, observed in derivation, not required by the validated matrix

services.name: com.apple.PowerManagement.control
services.description: power/sleep control — caffeinate (keep-awake during long agent work); confirmed needed in dogfooding, no data/escape exposure

services.name: com.apple.FSEvents
services.description: filesystem-change notifications — xcodebuild's build system and Claude's file-watching; heavily used in dogfooding. Leaks fs ACTIVITY (paths, not content) outside the readable set, an accepted tradeoff
